examples.en: A good service level indicator measures what users actually feel.
examples.zh: 好的服务等级指标量的是用户真切感受到的东西。

situation.en: Our service level indicator is the share of requests answered correctly within 300 milliseconds.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 服务等级指标（量化用户体验的度量）

examples.en: The service level objective allows a handful of bad minutes per month.
examples.zh: 服务等级目标允许每个月有几分钟不达标。

situation.en: We set the service level objective at 99.9 percent, measured on real user traffic.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 服务等级目标（给指标定的达标线）

examples.en: A service level agreement turns internal targets into contractual promises.
examples.zh: 服务等级协议把内部目标变成了合同承诺。

situation.en: The service level agreement promises credits when we miss, not just an apology.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 服务等级协议（对客户的合同承诺）

examples.en: The error budget policy freezes launches when the budget is spent.
examples.zh: 错误预算政策规定：预算花完就冻结发布。

situation.en: An error budget policy only works if leadership enforces it during incidents.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 错误预算政策（预算花完后冻结什么的约定）

examples.en: The golden signals fit on one dashboard per service.
examples.zh: 黄金指标一个服务一块仪表盘就装得下。

situation.en: Start with the golden signals; everything else is diagnosis detail.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 黄金指标（延迟、流量、错误、饱和度）

examples.en: Saturation shows up first in queue length, not CPU.
examples.zh: 饱和度最先体现在队列长度上，而不是 CPU。

situation.en: Our earliest saturation warning is connection pool wait time.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 饱和度（离资源上限还有多远）

examples.en: The RED method frames every service with rate, errors, and duration.
examples.zh: RED 方法用速率、错误和耗时三个维度看每个服务。

situation.en: For request-driven services I start with the RED method on every dashboard.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: RED 方法（速率、错误、耗时三看服务）

examples.en: The USE method checks utilization, saturation, and errors per resource.
examples.zh: USE 方法逐个资源看利用率、饱和度和错误。

situation.en: The USE method is my checklist when a single machine misbehaves.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: USE 方法（利用率、饱和度、错误三看资源）

examples.en: An actionable alert names the user impact and the first step.
examples.zh: 可行动告警会写明用户影响和第一步该做什么。

situation.en: If a page needs a wiki to interpret, it is not an actionable alert.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 可行动告警（收到就知道该做什么的告警）

examples.en: Symptom-based alerting pages on pain users can feel.
examples.zh: 基于症状的告警只盯用户能感受到的痛苦。

situation.en: We moved to symptom-based alerting and cut nightly pages by half.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 基于症状的告警（盯用户感受而非原因）

examples.en: Cause-based alerting catches known failure modes early.
examples.zh: 基于原因的告警能早早抓住已知的故障模式。

situation.en: Cause-based alerting belongs on tickets, not on the pager.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 基于原因的告警（盯具体故障源头）

examples.en: The paging threshold separates 'wake a human' from 'read it tomorrow'.
examples.zh: 呼叫阈值区分了“叫醒一个人”和“明天再看”。

situation.en: We tune the paging threshold against the error budget, not gut feeling.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 呼叫阈值（严重到要打电话叫人的线）

examples.en: Alert routing sends database pages to the storage team, not the app team.
examples.zh: 告警路由把数据库的呼叫送到存储团队，而不是应用团队。

situation.en: Half the incident delay was alert routing sending the page to a departed team.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 告警路由（把告警送到对的团队）

examples.en: A humane on-call rotation keeps the same faces out of every weekend.
examples.zh: 人性化的值班轮换不会让同一批人每个周末都中招。

situation.en: Our on-call rotation is weekly, with a follow-the-sun handoff.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 值班轮换（轮流当第一响应人）

examples.en: The escalation policy pages the manager after fifteen silent minutes.
examples.zh: 升级策略规定：静默十五分钟就呼叫经理。

situation.en: Every critical alert carries an escalation policy tested quarterly.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 升级策略（没人响应时逐级找人）

examples.en: The incident commander coordinates; the experts fix.
examples.zh: 事故指挥官负责协调；专家负责修。

situation.en: Naming an incident commander ended the everyone-fixes-everything chaos.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 事故指挥官（协调而非亲自修的人）

examples.en: Incident severity follows user impact, not internal drama.
examples.zh: 事故等级看的是用户影响，而不是内部有多热闹。

situation.en: We declare incident severity from the customer's point of view.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 事故等级（按影响范围定的级别）

examples.en: The incident retrospective produced three fixes and one deletion.
examples.zh: 这次事故回顾产出了三个修复和一个删除。

situation.en: An incident retrospective without owners and deadlines is theater.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 事故回顾（复盘会的另一种说法）

examples.en: Every postmortem action item has an owner and a date.
examples.zh: 每个复盘行动项都有负责人和日期。

situation.en: We track each postmortem action item like a product feature.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 复盘行动项（带负责人和期限的改进项）

examples.en: A blameless culture asks what made the wrong action feel right.
examples.zh: 无指责文化追问的是：是什么让错误动作当时看起来是对的。

situation.en: Blameless culture is not soft; it is how you get the true timeline.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 无指责文化（对事不对人的复盘氛围）

examples.en: Mean time to detect shrank once alerts keyed off user symptoms.
examples.zh: 告警盯住用户症状之后，平均检测时长缩短了。

situation.en: Our mean time to detect is four minutes; the budget says two.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 平均检测时长（故障发生到发现）

examples.en: Mean time to recover improved more from runbooks than from heroics.
examples.zh: 平均恢复时长的改善，靠手册比靠英雄主义多。

situation.en: Rehearsed rollbacks did more for mean time to recover than any tool.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 平均恢复时长（发现到恢复服务）

examples.en: Change failure rate counts deployments that needed a fix or rollback.
examples.zh: 变更失败率统计需要修复或回滚的发布占比。

situation.en: Our change failure rate halved after canaries became mandatory.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 变更失败率（发布引发故障的比例）

examples.en: Lead time for changes measures the commit-to-production path.
examples.zh: 变更前置时间量的是从提交到上线的路径。

situation.en: Small batches cut lead time for changes from days to hours.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 变更前置时间（提交到上线的时长）

examples.en: Automated canary analysis compares error rates against the baseline fleet.
examples.zh: 自动化的金丝雀分析会拿灰度组的错误率和基线机群对比。

situation.en: Canary analysis aborted the release before users noticed anything.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 金丝雀分析（对比灰度与基线的指标）

examples.en: Automated rollback fired two minutes into the bad deploy.
examples.zh: 发布出问题两分钟后，自动回滚就触发了。

situation.en: With automated rollback, a bad release is a blip, not an incident.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 自动回滚（指标变坏自动撤回发布）

examples.en: A load shedding strategy decides what to drop before the system decides for you.
examples.zh: 负载削减策略决定先丢什么，免得系统替你乱丢。

situation.en: Our load shedding strategy sacrifices recommendations first, checkout never.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 负载削减策略（过载时先丢什么的预案）

examples.en: Graceful degradation keeps checkout alive when recommendations die.
examples.zh: 优雅降级让推荐挂掉时结账依然可用。

situation.en: We design for graceful degradation instead of pretending failures won't happen.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 优雅降级（坏一部分、主功能照常）

examples.en: The throttling strategy limits per tenant, not per IP.
examples.zh: 限流策略按租户限制，而不是按 IP。

situation.en: A fair throttling strategy degrades the noisy neighbor, not everyone.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 限流策略（按什么维度限制谁）

examples.en: A retry budget caps retries as a share of total requests.
examples.zh: 重试预算把重试量封顶为总请求的一个比例。

situation.en: The retry budget stopped a sick service from multiplying its own traffic.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 重试预算（给重试总量封顶）

examples.en: Circuit breaker tuning balances fast failure against flapping.
examples.zh: 熔断调参要在快速失败和反复抖动之间找平衡。

situation.en: Most circuit breaker tuning pain comes from thresholds copied from a blog post.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 熔断调参（阈值与恢复探针的设置）

examples.en: Dependency fan-out multiplies both latency and failure probability.
examples.zh: 依赖扇出会同时放大延迟和故障概率。

situation.en: Cutting dependency fan-out did more for reliability than any single fix.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 依赖扇出（一个请求引爆的下游调用数）

examples.en: A chaos experiment states a hypothesis before breaking anything.
examples.zh: 混沌实验在动手搞坏任何东西之前先写明假设。

situation.en: We run one chaos experiment per quarter on the staging twin.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 混沌实验（带假设和度量的故障演练）

examples.en: A game day rehearses the incident with the whole team watching.
examples.zh: 演练日让整个团队一起排练事故处理。

situation.en: The game day exposed that our rollback needs a permission nobody on call has.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 演练日（团队一起模拟事故的练习）

examples.en: Failure injection in staging caught the timeout mismatch early.
examples.zh: 在预发环境做故障注入，提前抓住了超时配置不一致的问题。

situation.en: Start failure injection small: one instance, one dependency, business hours only.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 故障注入（主动把故障打进系统）

examples.en: The steady-state hypothesis names the metrics that must not move.
examples.zh: 稳态假设写明哪些指标不许动。

situation.en: Without a steady-state hypothesis, a chaos experiment is just breaking things.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 稳态假设（实验前先定义正常是什么样）

examples.en: Toil is the work that scales with the fleet instead of with value.
examples.zh: 琐务是那种随机器规模涨、却不随价值涨的工作。

situation.en: We budget toil at under half of SRE time; the rest goes to engineering.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 琐务（手工、重复、无沉淀的运维劳动）

examples.en: Operational load grows silently until the team drowns in it.
examples.zh: 运维负荷会悄悄增长，直到团队被它淹没。

situation.en: Every new service must declare its operational load before launch.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 运维负荷（页面、工单与琐务的总和）

examples.en: Production readiness is a checklist, not a vibe.
examples.zh: 生产就绪是一张清单，不是一种感觉。

situation.en: The launch slipped a week because production readiness review found no rollback plan.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 生产就绪（监控、回滚、容量都齐备）

examples.en: The launch readiness review walks dashboards, alerts, and capacity.
examples.zh: 上线就绪评审会过一遍仪表盘、告警和容量。

situation.en: Our launch readiness review killed two launches last year, both rightly.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 上线就绪评审（发布前的把关会）

examples.en: A capacity buffer absorbs the spike you failed to predict.
examples.zh: 容量缓冲吸收你没预测到的那次尖峰。

situation.en: We keep a thirty percent capacity buffer during campaign season.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 容量缓冲（预留的余量空间）

examples.en: The observability pipeline ships logs, metrics, and traces to one store.
examples.zh: 可观测性管道把日志、指标和链路送到一个存储里。

situation.en: A broken observability pipeline blinds you exactly when you need it most.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 可观测性管道（遥测数据的采集处理链路）

examples.en: Trace context propagation carries the trace id across every hop.
examples.zh: 链路上下文传播把 trace id 带过每一跳。

situation.en: One library skipped trace context propagation, and the trace broke there.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 链路上下文传播（把 trace id 带过服务边界）

examples.en: Each span records one operation with its timing and tags.
examples.zh: 每个跨度记录一个操作及其耗时和标签。

situation.en: A trace is a tree of spans; the slow span names the culprit.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 跨度（链路中的一段工作单元）

examples.en: Trace sampling keeps costs sane at a billion requests.
examples.zh: 链路采样让十亿级请求下的成本保持理智。

situation.en: With trace sampling at one percent, rare errors still slip through unseen.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 链路采样（只留一部分完整链路）

examples.en: Tail-based sampling keeps the interesting traces: errors and slow ones.
examples.zh: 尾部采样留下的是有意思的链路：出错的和慢的。

situation.en: We moved to tail-based sampling so failures are never the ones discarded.
situation.zh: 面试官问线上稳定性怎么做，你回答：

entries.zh: 尾部采样（看完整条链路再决定留不留）

examples.en: Log aggregation turns fifty machines into one searchable stream.
examples.zh: 日志聚合把五十台机器变成一条可搜索的流。

situation.en: Without log aggregation, the incident would have taken hours to piece together.
situation.zh: 故障复盘会上你这样总结：

entries.zh: 日志聚合（把各处日志汇到一起）

examples.en: Metric cardinality explodes when user ids sneak into labels.
examples.zh: 用户 id 混进标签时，指标基数就会爆炸。

situation.en: The outage of the monitoring system itself was a metric cardinality lesson.
situation.zh: 你在可靠性评审上这样说：

entries.zh: 指标基数（标签组合的总数，会爆炸）
